title: A later screening of a practice with a kept summary
assertion: The earlier summary is replaced at the later screening's completion (same address, or same ZIP and practice name), an audit event naming it; its request is carried over only by the same ZIP and practice name, and an address-only match leaves the request without a summary; the result page and email of a screening that took a request over say its details are kept with it; a failed, abandoned or refused resend deletes nothing, and a completion after expiry is refused
noFileReason: A replacement is two screenings the tests submit in memory; no file.
